issues_found.description: Reviewer provided empty assessment '{}' despite actual compilation failures. Two distinct failures occurred: (1) rustfmt not installed ('no such command: fmt'), and (2) cargo check failed in the 'time' crate dependency due to E0282 type annotation error in registry code. The reviewer failed to flag these failures or categorize them for judges.
issues_found.recommendation: Judges should treat both failures as ENVIRONMENTAL/PRE-EXISTING, not agent-caused. The agent patch is empty (no code changes), and both errors originate from system tooling or third-party dependencies, not agent-modified code.

notes: The rustfmt failure is purely environmental ('no such command: fmt'). The cargo_check_affected failure occurs in time-0.3.23 (a registry dependency) with a type inference error at src/format_description/parse/mod.rs:83 - this is not agent-modified code. With an empty agent diff, neither failure can be attributed to agent changes. The reviewer should have noted these as PRE-EXISTING/ENVIRONMENTAL issues rather than providing an empty assessment.
